# homeassistant_input_select (Resource)

A dropdown helper (`input_select`): one value out of a list of options.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A dropdown that starts at "eco" whenever Home Assistant starts. The entity is
# input_select.heating_mode.
resource "homeassistant_input_select" "heating_mode" {
  name    = "Heating Mode"
  options = ["off", "eco", "comfort"]
  initial = "eco"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Changing it renames the helper in place.
- `options` (List of String) The options, in the order the UI shows them. Must be non-empty and unique.

### Optional

- `icon` (String) Icon, e.g. `mdi:toggle-switch`.
- `id` (String) Helper ID, a slug such as `guest_mode`. Home Assistant derives it from `name` when the helper is created, and keeps it when the helper is renamed. Set it to choose the ID yourself. Changing it replaces the helper. Creation fails if the ID is taken. Import with this ID.
- `initial` (String) Option the helper starts with when Home Assistant starts; one of `options`. Unset, it restores the option it had before the restart. The provider never manages the current option.

### Read-Only

- `entity_id` (String) Entity ID of the helper, `input_select.<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an input_select helper by its ID.
tofu import homeassistant_input_select.heating_mode heating_mode
```
